scenes.title: Oslo Harbour
scenes.description: A photograph titled Oslo havn, showing the harbour in Oslo in 1956. It is held by the National Library of Norway and is in the public domain; the record does not name a photographer.
scenes.anomaly: Modern construction crane with air-conditioned operator cab
scenes.explanation: Tower cranes with enclosed operator cabs and hydraulic jibs did not exist in 1956; only simple scaffolding and hoists were available.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS, Brun, Jac via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Aerial Photograph of Sarpsborg Square and Centre
scenes.description: An aerial photograph from Widerøe Flyveselskaps flyfoto showing Sarpsborg torg and the town centre in Sarpsborg kommune, taken on 13 May 1950.
scenes.explanation: The first practical visible-spectrum LED was only demonstrated in 1962, so an LED street lamp cannot exist in a photograph taken in 1950.

scenes.title: Single-fare bus, interior view
scenes.description: An interior view of a single-fare autobus in Paris, photographed in 1931 by the Agence Rol press agency. The photograph is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie.
scenes.explanation: The quadcopter is a later-era object; consumer drones did not exist in 1931.

scenes.title: People on a Pier
scenes.description: A photograph from 1900, held by the National Library of Norway, shows persons on a brygge. The record does not name a photographer.
scenes.explanation: Telescoping aluminum selfie sticks did not exist in 1900; they became common consumer products only in the 1980s and later.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS, Neupert, Hermann Christian via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Oslo Girl on a Pier
scenes.description: A girl from Oslo stands on a pier in this photograph from 1900, held by the National Library of Norway. The image is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: The modern athletic sneaker with a thick rubber sole did not exist in 1900; the first mass-produced canvas rubber-soled sneakers appeared in 1917.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS, Neupert, Hermann Christian via National Library of Norway
